item.title: model selection : dredge() doesn't return models' weights
item.description:
Hey,
I'm having a hard time understanding why no weights are calculated for my models (the column is created but is full of NAs). Here is the full model : glmmTMB(LULARB\~etat\_parcelle\*typeMC2+vent+temp+pol+neb+occ\_sol+Axe1+date+heure+mat(pos\_env+0|id\_env)+(1|obs),family = binomial(link="logit"),data=compil\_env.bi,ziformula=\~1, na.action="na.pass")
and a glimpse of my results :
https://preview.redd.it/35sb2nm5xv3f1.png?width=1494&format=png&auto=webp&s=67e61e30d54ef9f0211fc5163f38bdfb802de92a
Does anyone could shed a light on this ..? May the dredge() function not handling glmmTMB() or some of its arguments (ziformula for zero-inflated model for example) be the reason of my problem?
Have a good day !
